I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer for this sorghum plot, and the FISP coupons I received I will use on my maize instead. But I will put manure on this plot because I have some from my animals. I am planting the same sorghum seed I have kept from last year, not the new seed from the shop, because sorghum grows well enough with what I have and I must save my money. I will not spray any medicine on it or irrigate it because we depend on the rains and sorghum does not need that. My family will do all the work on this small plot, from planting and weeding to harvest — about 35 days in total. I will not hire any ganyu laborers for this plot because it is small enough for us to manage ourselves.
